Attached: 1 image

Poznote 6.114.0 is here, bringing massive workflow improvements to the open-source note app 📝

New repeating tasks will now automatically add their next occurrence when you complete them. You can also copy deep links to specific headings in public notes, and Markdown printing perfectly preserves your diagrams.

Available soon on PikaPods!

Release: https://github.com/timothepoznanski/poznote/releases/tag/6.114.0
Run it: https://pikapods.com/pods?run=poznote

#opensource #ownyourdata
